transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Thanks for joining Priya. I wanted to walk through how we handle SSO and the security review.

transcript.speaker: Priya Chen
transcript.text: We like the product, but security is going to be the gate. Our bank client will not allow a cloud notetaker bot in the call.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Understood. Capture stays on the laptop. Audio only goes to the STT endpoint you configure.

transcript.speaker: Priya Chen
transcript.text: Implementation time is also a concern. Dana asked about this five weeks ago — we need first value in two weeks, not a six-month rollout.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Phased rollout. Two weeks to first value, then SSO in phase two. I'll send the SOC 2 report this week.

transcript.speaker: Priya Chen
transcript.text: Price is higher than the spreadsheet tool we use today. If you could do a usage-tier, that would help.
